scope: MEAS: independent checks/report, source, all current overlays including complete corrected strain close, actual public sheet/bar map and callers; not aural review.

It rejects the later 1.54 s opening recurrence and approximately three-second late second-strain close. q144/E-flat6=31.94 s and q155/A-flat4=36.12 s are explicitly fitting constraints, not independent validation. Actual public index equals Gurevich's inspected index; all three SVG trees match its fully inspected pages after only consistent DOM-prefix normalization. Real repeat at 21 and distinct alternatives 36/37, all printed bar identities and the final rest survive. Bar37's middle pickup is on beat3 before full bar38; later bare running figures at74 precede fuller accompaniment at78. Listening labels are coarse activity passages, not exact bar assertions.

overlays.finding: All fifteen current overlays independently inspected. The corrected source descending close now precedes the pause and A-flat4 pickup, rather than continuing through the pause. First note is 0.6 s. No remaining gross pitch/order mismatch identified in current windows. Constraints cannot be counted as independent onset validation; nearest-onset success is not every-note proof.
